verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a broad REST API v2 that can book meetings end-to-end, read and write Scheduling, Contacts and Notetaker data, create event types, read availability, manage users, and manage webhook subscriptions. An official MCP server exposes these endpoints as tools. However, nothing claims or shows UI parity, and many UI-side capabilities (Workflows, routing-form configuration, payments, polls, availability buffers/limits) have no evidenced API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, evidenced API coverage of Workflows, routing-form setup, payments, polls and availability-rule configuration, independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
